scope: Tracked application, package, scripts, test-vector, workflow and selected root configuration paths; excludes documentation. Exact changed-path/blob comparison only.
limits: No merge, conflict resolution, ref change, source edit, test or build was performed.
Two changed paths with different final blobs are review points, not proof of a Git merge conflict or incompatible behavior.
Single-side paths also require semantic/acceptance review before broader integration.
The current local qualified source maps to an identical published tree; the final docs-only successor does not alter product blobs.
reviewed_source_note: Comparison source includes independently reviewed two-line test callback correction; runtime is identical to runtime_review_source. Both changed test paths are current-only, so overlap blob/mode rows are unchanged.
